title: ACP agent declaration
description: One file per ACP agent. Declares everything a host needs to build the image, launch the adapter, and persist its credentials. Hosts must not carry per-agent knowledge outside this file.

id.description: Registry id. Also the image name: ghcr.io/moonrend/acp-registry/<id>.

version.description: Upstream version pinned by this declaration.

profileId.description: Stable host-side profile id. Replaces the host's hardcoded profile->registry map.

dist.description: How to install the adapter into the image.

sha256.description: binary: checksum, verified at build time.

constraints.description: uvx: pins for transitive deps upstream left unbounded, e.g. "agent-client-protocol==0.8.1". Needed when a breaking release of a shared library would otherwise break an already-pinned adapter.

storage.description: Unified credential/config persistence contract. Replaces per-agent branches in the host.

mode.description: home: persist whole $HOME. state-home: persist $HOME under a state dir with XDG vars. files: persist an explicit file list. none: stateless.

env.description: Extra env for the adapter process. ${STATE_DIR}/${RUNTIME_DIR}/${HOME_DIR} are expanded by the host.

xdg.description: Set XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME under the persisted home.

durable.description: Path relative to the durable root.

runtime.description: Path relative to the runtime state dir.

sync.description: When to copy the runtime copy back to durable storage.

when.description: Only apply this artifact for these setup modes. Omit for all modes.

auth.description: Which setup flows this agent supports, so the UI can render them generically.

apiKeyEnv.description: Env var names accepted for api_key mode.

noBrowserEnv.description: Env applied during oauth to force device-code instead of opening a browser.
